verdict.rationale: A live probe shows PayPal serves an llms.txt at developer.paypal.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, structured 'PayPal Developer Documentation' index). A second probe confirms markdown versions of doc pages (e.g., /api/rest.md), and many cited doc URLs are .md variants, which is agent-oriented docs that can be fed directly to an agent. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or documented coverage and depth of the llms.txt index, and independent/community corroboration of agents using it effectively.
